_hf_verification_2026_07_10.method: The original healthflex-in org repos are no longer accessible to Ayush (all 404 via gh api; he left May 2025), so PR data cannot be re-pulled from the GitHub API. However, private archive mirrors exist under vancityAyush/{healthflex.app,healthflex.api,doctors.app,stance-dashboard}, pushed 2025-09-19. These carry the FULL git history but ZERO pull requests (a mirror push does not transfer PRs). All figures below were recomputed from that git history on 2026-07-10.
_hf_verification_2026_07_10.identity_proof: Each email resolves to github_login 'vancityAyush' via GET /repos/vancityAyush/healthflex.app/commits/{sha}.author.login.
_hf_verification_2026_07_10.pr_reconstruction: PRs were reconstructed from merge commits on the default branch. Two message formats occur: 'Merge pull request #N from <branch>' and, where the repo enabled 'default to PR title for merge commits', '<PR Title> (#N)'. Attribution does NOT use the merge-commit author (that is whoever clicked Merge). Instead, for each merge commit the commits unique to the merged branch (parent1..parent2) are examined. 'strict' = 100% of those commits are Ayush's. 'majority' = >=50%.
_hf_verification_2026_07_10.line_counting: git log --no-merges --numstat on the default branch, filtered to Ayush's identities. 'hand_written' excludes lockfiles, /assets/, /dist/, /build/, Pods, .pbxproj, minified and binary assets. 'raw' includes everything. Prefer hand_written on a resume; raw is dominated by package-lock.json churn.

ayush_role_claim.claim: Lead architect across three surfaces - web (Next.js), the K10 cricket mobile app, and the Kabuni hardware camera

mobile_only_scope: Native iOS/Android apps carry Device Management; the website explicitly does not - firmware version and update, serial number, battery life, MAC address
All MVP session management runs through the app on a 1-to-1 relationship; explicitly NOT a web feature
Camera pairing and control: scan for camera, ownership model of one camera to one account (non-transferable once set up), transient-user connection, one active camera at a time
Batting-session capture: camera clips media and routes it to the user's account
mobile_domain_complexity: Biometric facial-recognition login through the camera, triggered by a 'KABUNI LOGIN' voice command, matching against a cloud-held face matrix and auto-logging-out the previous batter

Three-tier offline degradation: cloud login over 5G/WiFi, else mobile-app override with manual batter selection from the parent/child roster, else local storage on the camera for later manual transfer
India legally prohibits tracking users via biometric data, forcing possible geo-locking of the first device release
Parent/child account hierarchy (Institution owns and assigns seats to Individuals) with onboarding and off-boarding workflows; an Individual may belong to many Institutions
Media library with session-level grouping of stitched clips, a one-time-use analyze action, and recall/download/delete
Video upload with a quality gate that scores footage and rejects it below threshold
AI coaching feedback rendered as the user's selected Super Coach via HeyGen/ElevenLabs
GDPR audit trail with aged-data removal, right-to-be-forgotten, and data-request handling
Reward mechanics: 1 point per recorded shot, 2 per completed session, 0.5 per video upload
Navigation constraint of no more than 3 hops to complete a task and always one hop back to home, for a 12-16 year-old demographic
